name: FSD50K: Human-Labeled Sound Events Dataset
description: FSD50K is an open audio dataset containing 51,197 audio clips (108.3 hours) drawn from Freesound and human-labeled across 200 sound classes hierarchically organized using Google's AudioSet Ontology. Audio clips feature natural environmental, human, animal, musical, and domestic sounds with ground truth vocabulary labels.
